# Compared To What

> Every common AI criticism answered with data and context — interactive companion to the 'compared to what?' framing for evaluating AI's impact in context, not in isolation. This site is one of several maintained by Aragorn Meulendijks (MrMetaverse) — futurist, keynote speaker, AI explorer.

## About this site

- [https://compared-to-what.itsmrmetaverse.com](https://compared-to-what.itsmrmetaverse.com): The interactive site itself.

## 2026 update (30 September 2026)

- Measured per-prompt footprint: a median Gemini text prompt uses 0.24 Wh and 0.26 mL of on-site cooling water (Google, Aug 2025); OpenAI's CEO reports ~0.34 Wh and ~0.32 mL per average ChatGPT query (Jun 2025; method and boundary not published).
- All data centres: ~485 TWh in 2025 (+17%), ~950 TWh by 2030, about 3% of world electricity (IEA, Apr 2026). Global space cooling: ~2,100 TWh (2022).
- One hamburger's river and groundwater (~80 L) equals roughly 1,800 AI replies on Mistral's full life-cycle count, or ~59,000 Gemini text prompts including estimated US power-plant water (our estimate).
- Changelog on the page lists every superseded number (old to new, with dates).
